excerpts.label: Mortgage buying = house prices up
excerpts.insight: Fannie/Freddie $200B buying lowers mortgage rate but bids up houses. Real impact is not affordability—just lower headline rate.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Don't confuse mortgage rate cut with affordability. House prices get bid. Short banks—affordability thrust targets them.

excerpts.label: Private-sector QE if unhedged
excerpts.insight: If Fannie/Freddie run naked duration instead of matched book, it's forced QE—removing duration from market. Swap spreads already reacting.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Watch if Fannie hedges or not. Unhedged = bullish term premium. Swap spreads least-negative = Fannie becoming payers.

excerpts.label: Short banks—affordability target
excerpts.insight: Credit card cap + mortgage buying = banks in crosshairs. Don't own them in this environment.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: SHORT banks into earnings. Affordability thrust makes them target. KBW, BKX, XLF fade.

excerpts.label: Vol dirt cheap—must own
excerpts.insight: Equity puts, bond puts dirt cheap. Calls also cheap. Must own whether hedging or alpha. JHEQX collar levels approaching.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: BUY equity puts, bond puts. Cheap both ways. Scale into puts on rallies, calls on dips. March 31 JHEQX levels.

excerpts.label: Curve squeeze was positioning
excerpts.insight: Friday flattening was overloaded boat on steepeners/weak dollar getting squeezed. Not a trend break—minor retrace in broader trend.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: STAY in steepeners. Positioning squeeze, not trend change. Long twos, short 10Y puts. Scale trade.

excerpts.label: Trump Fed hasn't backed off
excerpts.insight: Myran at 2.125% dot hasn't changed despite 5% GDP boasts. Administration mouthpiece still dovish. Bessent at 2.5-3.25%.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Watch Myran. Terminal 3.16% vs Myran 2.125% = cuts underpriced. Long front-end.
